fields.name: SequenceLengthening
fields.contract: A public enum that lets a caller select one retry-backoff lengthening mode: Linear (0), Lengthening (1, the default odd-number progression 1, 3, 5, 7… × interval), HalfSquare (2), or Squaring (3). Fibonacci is an [Obsolete] alias declared as Fibonacci = Lengthening, retained so existing code and configuration values of "Fibonacci" still compile and bind (configuration binding parses enum names case-insensitively, so "Fibonacci" binds to the Lengthening value); because the two names share one value, ToString() of that value may return either name. The selected value is consumed by retry-delay resolution; it is not an open-ended numeric option.
